notes: War mode: Apex's own War mode switch (rally fill, carpets, reinforce, gear switch, guild chat) replaces the engine's war mode. Events: Arcane Cipher pass claims, Storm Fox rescue, and turf quests are now claimed by Apex itself (a Claim turf quests toggle in Setup; the engine's own turf collector is switched off). Tag bar: Jump to tag finder, pinned tags, Ctrl+click for more than one. A one-character setting such as the command prefix can no longer be saved with more than one character, which had stopped an account on load. Server: matching relay checks and tables.
